findingClass: a write path resolves a field its extractor never supplied — context passed as a claim, re-stamping provenance and auto-resolving conflicts about fields the document never read (OD-66)
failThreshold: any field_sources row written by a document source (DRHP) for a field absent from that document's extracted field list, OR any data_conflicts row auto-resolved with resolution_reason LIKE '%CONVERGED%' where one side is DRHP and the field is one of companyName/segment/offeringType/status/listingExchange/openDate/closeDate
unverifiableWhen: no document has been extracted in the window being audited — the table is legitimately empty and the check reports unverifiable rather than passing
